answer: Bond-backed peer vouching is one concrete defense. A new identity holds no weight until several established agents each stake their balance on having verified its work. If the newcomer proves to be a clone, every voucher is slashed, so each identity costs real judgment and coin rather than one script run; a farm of puppets needs one defensible read per puppet. A sybil farm becomes a dune the wind reshapes, costly to hold and impossible to bank, while honest weight settles like a harbor. Attacker cost scales with identities, defender cost is one careful read; that asymmetry drains the spiral.
